subject: General
notes: Rule: "If the ACCESS MODE clause is not specified, sequential access is assumed." (cite.py --check 12.4.5.5.3 -> OK §12.4.5.5.3 1)). FileModel.AccessMode defaults to FileAccessMode.Sequential (FileModel.cs:128) and is only overwritten by a written clause (DataBinder.cs:994); the ordinal passes to the runtime KeyedAccess.Sequential=0. Probe gA.cob: INDEXED file with no ACCESS clause, WRITE 'C3' then 'A1' -> statuses 00 then 21 (sequence error, the sequential-access indexed WRITE rule), proving sequential access was assumed; gB.cob: RELATIVE with no ACCESS clause reads records in ascending RRN (R2,R5,R9) with plain READ. Both at --std 85 and 2023. No spec-derived golden asserts the default specifically. [registrar 14a — editions as adjudicated: 1985, 2002, 2014, 2023 (Annex E lists no substantive change to the ACCESS MODE clause)]
